source: flow_graph/plant_flow_graph.json node AL_POT (graph revision AC); docs-authority/duties/AL_POT.md sections 2, 3, 4 and 6; docs-authority/nozzles/AL_POT.csv (task 04 schedule); models/mfg/AL_POT/WORK_ORDER.md; models/mfg/AL_POT/bom.csv rows 1-7 (AQS-DUTY-072 basis)
size_basis: duty section 2 envelope (graph node): cell-class study minimum, bath 0.5 d hold at 1800 kg/m3, electrodes and busbar from the Faraday current (A-M-282)

design.note: graph design row (AQS-PAR-001). Atmospheric dry-Cl2 headspace (M7); no design pressure and no relief case on the duty section 6 - the hood works at slight negative draft; hood draft interlock is the WO step 5 control item.

bath.basis: melt level, freeboard and layer thicknesses are study assumptions for the assembly geometry (melt top below the z=600 Cl2 nozzles keeps the headspace dry, M7); the graph envelope basis states the 0.5 d bath hold at 1800 kg/m3 - no residence-time claim is made

anode.rodding: z 100 .. 1000 (400 mm immersion from the melt top 500)
anode.basis: bom.csv row 2 and WORK_ORDER step 2: 5 x D75 at 400 mm immersion. Count is the issued BOM quantity; at the drawn geometry the anode current density is 1461 A / (5 sections) ~= 0.30 A/cm2, inside the A-M-282 class j 0.5 A/cm2 envelope stated on duty section 3 (conservative, no rate claimed).

cathode.basis: duty section 2 graph design row 'cathodes 5' (AQS-PAR-001). bom.csv row 3 and WORK_ORDER step 2 say 4 - corrected to the design row here, logged in build_log.md.

busbar.mount: on the casing roof, frame-isolated (ceramic pads) per AQS-STD-002 section 11
busbar.basis: bom.csv row 4; 32 x 31 mm = 992 mm2 drawn for the 975 mm2 class rail

hood.hot_plate: graphite t10 (expendable wetted face; the duty section 3 10 mm design allowance is the plate itself)
hood.offtake: DN150 riser OD168.3 t4.0 (sch 10), CS, hood centre offset (+90,+90), top flange z 1160
hood.dip_leg: DN50 OD60.3, Hastelloy C-276, concentric downcomer inside the riser annulus, bottom z 250 (250 mm submerged)
hood.basis: bom.csv row 5; N4 Cl2 export 39.4192 kg/d at the CRU (A-M-280 ruling); dry hot gas above the AlCl3 dew point (M7)

nozzles.drawn: metal siphon: carbon well tube DN80 (OD 88.9) from the bottom metal layer up over the siphon crest, discharge lip at +X z 600; heat-traced (WO step 6 trial electrolysis)

nozzles.drawn_d: side chute box 140(w) x 140(h) with hopper cone and rotary seal flange, refractory lance DN100 (OD 114.3 t4.0) into the melt, sub-surface feed

nozzles.drawn_bore: DN15 drain well: carbon tube OD60 through the base stack, sump face z 50, flush at z 0 (frozen-salt drain pig per WO step 6)
DN15 OD21.3 t2.77 stub on the DN150 offtake riser at z 800

layout_note: The task-04 schedule gives height, bore class and rating per connection but not the compass wall; the face assignment above is this layout's study choice, so the drawing register and the schedule never disagree.

parts_material.casing: carbon steel (CS class, duty section 3 mild-steel outer shell below the liner), t6, CA 0 (dry, outside the lining)
parts_material.lining_fibre: ceramic-fibre board t24 (backup lining per SCHACHT2004 class)
parts_material.lining_ram: graphite ramming paste t40 (wetted liner; duty section 3 design allowance 10 mm on wetted faces is inside this thickness)
parts_material.hood: carbon steel t6; Hastelloy C-276 dip leg; CS DN150 riser (dry hot Cl2, M7)
parts_material.bus: Cu ETP on ceramic isolation pads (AQS-STD-002 section 11)
parts_material.product_layer: Al (process inventory, shown as solids, not a BOM part)
parts_material.melt: NaCl-KCl-AlCl3 (process inventory, shown as solid, not a BOM part)

assumptions.casing_steel: CS (S235 class), 0 CA - outside the lining, dry
assumptions.allowable_note: shop proportions chosen inside size_mm to fit the duty envelope and the task-04 schedule; not measured, not a design calculation. Graph values (anode D/immersion, cathode count, bus class, bath T) are reproduced verbatim.
assumptions.corr_allowance_note: duty section 3: 10 mm design allowance on graphite wetted faces carried by the t40 ram liner and the t10 hood hot plate; no metal CA claimed (dry CS outside the lining, Hastelloy dip leg).

fasteners_ref: models/mfg/AL_POT/fasteners.csv (clamp studs 10, hood rim bolts 16, casing anchors 4; torque in WORK_ORDER step 3)
